architecture_changes.name: FIRST_CLASS_EFFECT_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE
architecture_changes.change: Persist exact verified outcome evidence atomically with effect outcome state in canonical UnifiedDB, including provider receipt identity and receipt hash.
architecture_changes.reason: V14 persisted only outcome_hash; V17.1 referenced a non-existent evidence column and therefore could not prove provider-evidence closure.

architecture_changes.name: PREDICTION_SUBJECT_BINDING
architecture_changes.change: A causal prediction used to authorize effect re-entry must bind its subject to the exact effect identity, not merely share cycle/provider/credit identities.

architecture_changes.name: SEMANTIC_DELTA_CAUSAL_SOURCE
architecture_changes.change: A CURRENT semantic record requires an explicit source relation to the same causal support/effect/credit before it can be admitted as an effect-derived delta.

architecture_changes.name: WAL_FAIL_CLOSED_STORAGE_SELECTION
architecture_changes.change: Affected/unproven SQLite builds use rollback-journal DELETE + synchronous=FULL; normal runtime opens reject an affected/unproven database that is still WAL. Upstream-fixed versions may retain WAL.
architecture_changes.reason: Current target version/topology lies inside documented WAL-reset preconditions and downstream backport status is unproven.
